name: path-distribute-shapes
title: Path Distribute Shapes
description: Hand-drawn letter outlines draw on, small squares pop onto every line, then slide along their paths so each lands at its own distributed point, shift colour and size in waves, round into dots, flatten into bars, converge on the centre as a line, and a headline rises from beneath it.
useWhen: A word or a few outlines should dissolve into a swarm of small shapes that reorganise and then resolve into a headline.
A technical-looking title sequence with stagger and distribute rhythm.
avoidWhen: The lettering must be your own word: the 'DISTRIBUTE' outlines are fixed art (replace the path data).
A short, calm title is wanted: the full sequence takes about ten seconds.
author: PointC
